purpose: Local calibration/regression replay of the next precision improvements. The login and permissions cases informed tuning; all five cases are treated as calibration, not held-out quality estimates. Positive labels are sparse. Timings are single local samples and do not establish a speedup.

source.construction: Pinned Git archive augmented with the same four generated assets as the earlier replay, plus captured ignore settings. Evaluation uses temporary copies. Original saved packs have matching SHA256 hashes before and after validation.

before.description: Development 0.3.1 before the four new precision improvements, with the earlier retrieval and token fixes. Release profile.

after.description: Working tree 0.3.1 with lexical provenance, typed traversal, scoped runtime dependencies and marginal selection. Release profile. No release was published.

additionalValidation.historicalResult: Three pinned historical cases pass with recall 1 and recallAt5 1, including the training case for native import resolution.
additionalValidation.excerptLoopRegression: The previous and new development builds both timed out on overlapping class/method clipping under a 250-token budget. Accepted allocations now require added source lines; a subprocess regression has a 5-second timeout.
